global.description: Global values that apply to the chart and its dependencies. See [global](/truecharts-common/global).

namespace.description: Namespace to create all objects in, unless overridden at the object level. Does not apply to chart dependencies, use `global.namespace` for that.

image.description: The main image of the chart, used by containers that do not select another image with `imageSelector`. See [image](/truecharts-common/image).

chartContext.description: Details about the release that common works out on every render, such as the URL of the app. Common sets these itself.

createChartContextConfigmap.description: Creates a ConfigMap `chart-context` with the generated `chartContext`. Only used in CI and unittests, to check the generated chart context.

common.description: Values merged into the common defaults before the values of the chart. Takes the same values as the chart itself.

securityContext.description: Default security contexts for all containers and pods, unless overridden at the container or pod level. See [securityContext](/truecharts-common/securityContext).

resources.description: Default CPU and memory resources of each container, unless overridden at the container level. They apply to every container, not to the pod as a whole. See [resources](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/resources).

containerOptions.description: Options that apply to all containers, unless overridden at the container level. See [containerOptions](/truecharts-common/containerOptions).

podOptions.description: Options that apply to all pods, unless overridden at the pod level. See [podOptions](/truecharts-common/podOptions).

workload.description: Workloads (Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, Job, CronJob), keyed by name. Each one holds a pod spec and its containers. See [workload](/truecharts-common/workload).

TZ.description: Timezone set as the `TZ` environment variable of the containers, unless overridden at the container level.

diagnosticMode.description: Run the containers with a sleep command instead of the app, so you can exec into them to debug.

vpa.description: VerticalPodAutoscalers, keyed by name. Each one scales the resources of a workload.

hpa.description: HorizontalPodAutoscalers, keyed by name. Each one scales the replicas of a workload.

service.description: Services, keyed by name. Each one exposes a workload on one or more ports. See [service](/truecharts-common/service).

credentials.description: Credentials for S3 compatible backup targets, keyed by name.

ingressMiddlewares.description: Ingress middlewares (Traefik Middleware objects), keyed by ingress controller and then by name. See [middlewares](/truecharts-common/ingressMiddlewares).

persistence.description: Volumes, keyed by name. Each one is a PVC, emptyDir, hostPath, secret, configmap or other volume type, mounted into containers. See [persistence](/truecharts-common/persistence).

imagePullSecret.description: Image pull secrets, keyed by name, for pulling images from a private registry.

rbac.description: Roles and RoleBindings (or ClusterRoles and ClusterRoleBindings), keyed by name.

notes.description: Content of `NOTES.txt`, shown after install and upgrade.

gluetunImage.description: Image of the gluetun VPN client, used by the gluetun addon.

netshootImage.description: Image of netshoot, a network troubleshooting toolbox, used by the netshoot addon.

tailscaleImage.description: Image of Tailscale, used by the tailscale addon.

codeserverImage.description: Image of code-server, used by the codeserver addon.

ubuntuImage.description: Image of Ubuntu, used by the init containers that fix permissions (autoperms) and by the wait-for-database init containers.

kubectlImage.description: Image of kubectl, for containers that select it with `imageSelector: kubectlImage`.

postgresClientImage.description: Image of the PostgreSQL client, used by the init container that waits for the postgresql dependency.

mariadbClientImage.description: Image of the MariaDB client, used by the init container that waits for the mariadb dependency.

valkeyClientImage.description: Image of the Valkey client tools, used by the init container that waits for the valkey dependency.

mongodbClientImage.description: Image of the MongoDB shell, used by the init container that waits for the mongodb dependency.

postgres15Image.description: Image of PostgreSQL 15 (CloudNativePG), used by CNPG clusters of the postgresql dependency with `pgVersion: 15`.

postgres16Image.description: Image of PostgreSQL 16 (CloudNativePG), used by CNPG clusters of the postgresql dependency with `pgVersion: 16`.

postgresPostgis15Image.description: Image of PostgreSQL 15 with PostGIS (CloudNativePG), used by CNPG clusters with `pgVersion: 15` and the `postgis` type.

postgresPostgis16Image.description: Image of PostgreSQL 16 with PostGIS (CloudNativePG), used by CNPG clusters with `pgVersion: 16` and the `postgis` type.

postgresVectors15Image.description: Image of PostgreSQL 15 with pgvecto.rs (CloudNativePG), used by CNPG clusters with `pgVersion: 15` and the `vectors` type.

postgresVectors16Image.description: Image of PostgreSQL 16 with pgvecto.rs (CloudNativePG), used by CNPG clusters with `pgVersion: 16` and the `vectors` type.

postgresVectorchord15Image.description: Image of PostgreSQL 15 with VectorChord (CloudNativePG), used by CNPG clusters with `pgVersion: 15` and the `vectorchord` type.

postgresVectorchord16Image.description: Image of PostgreSQL 16 with VectorChord (CloudNativePG), used by CNPG clusters with `pgVersion: 16` and the `vectorchord` type.

ingress.description: Ingresses, keyed by name. Each one routes external traffic to a service. See [ingress](/truecharts-common/ingress).

route.description: Gateway API routes (HTTPRoute, GRPCRoute, TCPRoute, TLSRoute, UDPRoute), keyed by name. See [route](/truecharts-common/route).

podDisruptionBudget.description: Pod Disruption Budgets, keyed by name.

webhook.description: Webhook configurations (validating and mutating), keyed by name.

metrics.description: ServiceMonitors, PodMonitors and PrometheusRules, keyed by name. See [metrics](/truecharts-common/metrics).

addons.description: Addons that add containers or objects to the workloads, such as a VPN, Tailscale or code-server. See [addons](/truecharts-common/addons).

dependencies.description: Services the app needs, such as a database or cache, deployed with the chart. See [dependencies](/truecharts-common/dependencies).

cnpg.description: CloudNativePG clusters, keyed by name (`main` by default). See [cnpg](/truecharts-common/cnpg).

extraTpl.description: Extra Kubernetes resources to render, one per list item, as a YAML object or as a string. Helm `tpl` is resolved in each item.

scratchImage.description: Empty scratch image, for helper containers.

redisClientImage.description: Image of the Redis client, used by the init container that waits for the redis dependency.

openvpnImage.description: Image of the OpenVPN client, for the OpenVPN addon.

wireguardImage.description: Image of WireGuard, for the WireGuard addon.

networkPolicy.description: Network policies, keyed by name. See [networkPolicy](/truecharts-common/networkPolicy).

TZ.description: Timezone set as the `TZ` environment variable of the containers, unless overridden at the container level.

codeserver.description: A code-server container to edit the files of the app.

gluetun.description: A gluetun VPN container that routes the traffic of the pod.

netshoot.description: A netshoot container to debug the network of the pod.

tailscale.description: A tailscale container that connects the pod to a tailnet.

vpn.description: Removed vpn add-on. Only an empty object is accepted, any key is rejected, use `addons.gluetun` or `addons.tailscale` instead.

includeCommon.description: Marker for charts that the dependency uses common. Not read by common.

ping.description: URL of the ping endpoint, used by the wait container.

enabled.description: Enables the CNPG cluster. Supports Helm `tpl`.

annotations.description: Additional annotations for all CNPG objects.

disableDefaultQueries.description: Do not run the default queries of the metrics exporter.

usage.description: Usage of the column, eg `LABEL`, `GAUGE` or `COUNTER`.

customQueries.description: Additional queries for the metrics exporter.

destinationPath.description: Overrides the provider specific default path of the object store for the backups. Defaults to `s3://<bucket>/<path>/<release name>/cnpg`.

target.description: Instance the backups are taken from, `primary` or `prefer-standby`. Empty uses the default of CloudNativePG.

credentials.description: Name of the credentials in `credentials` for the object store of the backups. Required when backups are enabled.

immediate.description: Also take a backup right away.

annotations.description: Additional annotations for this scheduled backup, merged with `backups.annotations`.

items.description: A recurring backup of the cluster, created as a CNPG `ScheduledBackup`.

scheduledBackups.description: Backups that are taken on a schedule.

retentionPolicy.description: Retention policy of the backups: a number followed by `d` (days), `w` (weeks) or `m` (months), eg `30d`.

backups.description: Backups of the cluster to a barman object store.

seccompProfile.description: Seccomp profile of the container (`seccompProfile`), which restricts the system calls it can make.

runAsUser.description: User ID the container process runs as (`runAsUser`).

runAsGroup.description: Group ID the container process runs as (`runAsGroup`).

readOnlyRootFilesystem.description: Whether the root filesystem of the container is read-only (`readOnlyRootFilesystem`). Mount a `persistence` volume where the app needs to write.

allowPrivilegeEscalation.description: Whether a process can gain more privileges than its parent (`allowPrivilegeEscalation`).

privileged.description: Whether the container runs in privileged mode, with almost all the capabilities of the node (`privileged`). Prefer adding single `capabilities`.

runAsNonRoot.description: Whether the container must run as a non-root user (`runAsNonRoot`). Common always calculates it: `false` when `runAsUser` or `runAsGroup` is `0`, otherwise `true`.

add.description: Capabilities that are added to the container, eg `NET_ADMIN`. Names are without the `CAP_` prefix.

drop.description: Capabilities that are dropped from the container. `ALL` drops every capability.

disableS6Caps.description: Disable the capabilities that common adds automatically for S6 based images (`CHOWN`, `SETUID`, `SETGID`, `FOWNER` and `DAC_OVERRIDE`) when the container runs as root.

capabilities.description: Linux capabilities of the container (`capabilities`). Only rendered when at least one capability is set in `add` or `drop`.

PUID.description: User ID that is passed to the container as the `PUID` environment variable. Overridable with `fixedEnv.PUID`.

UMASK.description: File creation mask that is passed to the container as the `UMASK` environment variable. Overridable with `fixedEnv.UMASK`.

workload.podSpec.containers.securityCont.description: Security context of the container. Overrides `securityContext.container` for this container. See [securityContext](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/securityContext).

workload.podSpec.dnsPolicy.description: DNS policy of the pods (`dnsPolicy`): `ClusterFirst`, `ClusterFirstWithHostNet`, `Default` or `None`. It is forced to `ClusterFirstWithHostNet` when `hostNetwork` is `true`. Overrides `podOptions.dnsPolicy` for this workload.

workload.podSpec.enableServiceLinks.description: Whether Kubernetes injects environment variables for the Services of the namespace into the containers (`enableServiceLinks`). Overrides `podOptions.enableServiceLinks` for this workload.

workload.podSpec.hostIPC.description: Whether the containers share the IPC namespace of the node (`hostIPC`). Overrides `podOptions.hostIPC` for this workload.

workload.podSpec.hostNetwork.description: Whether the pods use the network namespace of the node (`hostNetwork`). `dnsPolicy` is set to `ClusterFirstWithHostNet` automatically when this is `true`. Overrides `podOptions.hostNetwork` for this workload.

workload.podSpec.hostPID.description: Whether the containers can see the processes of the node (`hostPID`). Overrides `podOptions.hostPID` for this workload.

workload.podSpec.hostUsers.description: Whether the pods use the user namespace of the node (`hostUsers`). When `false`, the pod gets its own user namespace. When not set, common calculates it. Overrides `podOptions.hostUsers` for this workload.

type.description: When the init container runs: `install` only on install, `upgrade` only on upgrade, `system` and `init` on every start. They are run in this order: `install`, `upgrade`, `system`, then `init`.

enabled.description: Whether the init container is created.

imageSelector.description: Name of the image to use. It is a key on the root of the values that holds `repository`, `tag` and `pullPolicy`, eg `image`.

command.description: Entrypoint of the init container (`command`). A single command can be given as a string.

args.description: Arguments of the init container (`args`). A single argument can be given as a string.

env.description: Environment variables of the init container, keyed by name.

envFrom.description: ConfigMaps and Secrets whose keys all become environment variables of the init container.

resources.description: CPU, memory and extended resources the init container requests and may use.

securityContext.description: Security context of the init container. Overrides `securityContext.container`.

termination.description: Where the termination message of the init container is read from.

probes.description: Accepted for compatibility with the shared container shape. The init container spawner replaces probes with disabled probes.

additionalProperties.description: An init container of the pod. It supports the settings of a container, except `lifecycle`, `primary` and working probes.

workload.podSpec.initContainers.description: Init containers of the pod, keyed by name. They run before the other containers start. See [initContainers](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/initContainers).

workload.podSpec.priorityClassName.description: Name of the PriorityClass of the pods (`priorityClassName`), which sets their scheduling priority. Overrides `podOptions.priorityClassName` for this workload.

workload.podSpec.restartPolicy.description: Restart policy of the pods (`restartPolicy`): `Always`, `OnFailure` or `Never`. Deployments, StatefulSets and DaemonSets only allow `Always`. Jobs and CronJobs default to `OnFailure` and do not allow `Always`. Overrides `podOptions.restartPolicy` for this workload.

workload.podSpec.runtimeClassName.description: Name of the RuntimeClass of the pods (`runtimeClassName`), to run them with another container runtime. Overrides `podOptions.runtimeClassName` for this workload.

workload.podSpec.schedulerName.description: Name of the scheduler that schedules the pods (`schedulerName`). The default scheduler is used when empty. Overrides `podOptions.schedulerName` for this workload.

fsGroup.description: Group ID applied to mounted volumes.

fsGroupChangePolicy.description: Policy controlling when ownership and permissions of volume contents are changed.

supplementalGroups.description: Additional group IDs applied to containers in the pod.

sysctls.description: Kernel parameters to set in the pod's network namespace.

workload.podSpec.shareProcessNamespace.description: Whether all containers of a pod share one process namespace (`shareProcessNamespace`), so they can see and signal each other's processes. Overrides `podOptions.shareProcessNamespace` for this workload.

workload.terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds Kubernetes waits for the containers to stop after they receive SIGTERM, before it kills them (`terminationGracePeriodSeconds`). Overrides `podOptions.terminationGracePeriodSeconds` for this workload.

env.description: Environment variables of the container, keyed by name. See [env](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/env).

resources.description: CPU, memory and extended resources the container requests and may use. See [resources](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/resources).

securityContext.description: Security context of the container. Overrides `securityContext.container` for this container. See [securityContext](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/securityContext).

enabled.description: Whether the container is created.

imageSelector.description: Name of the image to use. It is a key on the root of the values that holds `repository`, `tag` and `pullPolicy`, eg `image`.

primary.description: Whether this is the primary container of the workload. Does **not** apply to `initContainers`.

stdin.description: Whether stdin stays open for the container (`stdin`).

tty.description: Whether a TTY is allocated for the container (`tty`).

probes.description: Liveness, readiness and startup probes of the container. Does **not** apply to `initContainers`. See [probes](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/probes).

command.description: Entrypoint of the container (`command`), which replaces the entrypoint of the image. A single command can be given as a string. See [command](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/command).

lifecycle.description: `postStart` and `preStop` hooks of the container. See [lifecycle](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/lifecycle).

envFrom.description: ConfigMaps and Secrets whose keys all become environment variables of the container. See [envFrom](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/envFrom).

termination.description: Where the termination message of the container is read from. See [termination](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/termination).

fixedEnv.description: Overrides of the environment variables that common sets on every container: `TZ`, `UMASK`, `PUID` and `NVIDIA_CAPS`. See [fixedEnv](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/fixedEnv).

args.description: Arguments of the container (`args`), which replace the `CMD` of the image. A single argument can be given as a string. See [args](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers/args).

extraArgs.description: Arguments that are appended **after** `args`, as a string or a list.

value.description: Value of the environment variable. Supports Helm `tpl` on strings.

envList.description: Environment variables of the container as a list of name and value pairs.

additionalProperties.description: A container of the pod. The shared container settings are in [container](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/containers).

containers.description: Containers of the pod, keyed by name.

initContainers.description: Init containers of the pod, keyed by name. See [initContainers](/truecharts-common/workload/podSpec/initContainers).

labels.description: Additional labels for the pods of this workload.

annotations.description: Additional annotations for the pods of this workload.

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Whether the service account token is mounted into the pods (`automountServiceAccountToken`). Overrides `podOptions.automountServiceAccountToken` for this workload.

hostNetwork.description: Whether the pods use the network namespace of the node (`hostNetwork`). `dnsPolicy` is set to `ClusterFirstWithHostNet` automatically when this is `true`. Overrides `podOptions.hostNetwork` for this workload.

hostPID.description: Whether the containers can see the processes of the node (`hostPID`). Overrides `podOptions.hostPID` for this workload.

hostIPC.description: Whether the containers share the IPC namespace of the node (`hostIPC`). Overrides `podOptions.hostIPC` for this workload.

hostUsers.description: Whether the pods use the user namespace of the node (`hostUsers`). When `false`, the pod gets its own user namespace. When not set, common calculates it. Overrides `podOptions.hostUsers` for this workload.

shareProcessNamespace.description: Whether all containers of a pod share one process namespace (`shareProcessNamespace`), so they can see and signal each other's processes. Overrides `podOptions.shareProcessNamespace` for this workload.

enableServiceLinks.description: Whether Kubernetes injects environment variables for the Services of the namespace into the containers (`enableServiceLinks`). Overrides `podOptions.enableServiceLinks` for this workload.

restartPolicy.description: Restart policy of the pods (`restartPolicy`): `Always`, `OnFailure` or `Never`. Deployments, StatefulSets and DaemonSets only allow `Always`. Jobs and CronJobs default to `OnFailure` and do not allow `Always`. Overrides `podOptions.restartPolicy` for this workload.

schedulerName.description: Name of the scheduler that schedules the pods (`schedulerName`). The default scheduler is used when empty. Overrides `podOptions.schedulerName` for this workload.

priorityClassName.description: Name of the PriorityClass of the pods (`priorityClassName`), which sets their scheduling priority. Overrides `podOptions.priorityClassName` for this workload.

hostname.description: Hostname of the pods (`hostname`). It must be a valid DNS label.

affinity.description: Affinity rules of the pods, passed on as is. Overrides `podOptions.affinity` for this workload.

additionalProperties.description: A setting passed on as is.

serviceAccountName.description: Name of the service account the pods use (`serviceAccountName`). When not set, common uses the service account that targets this workload, or `default`. Supports Helm `tpl`.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds Kubernetes waits for the containers to stop after they receive SIGTERM, before it kills them (`terminationGracePeriodSeconds`). Overrides `podOptions.terminationGracePeriodSeconds` for this workload.

nodeSelector.description: Labels a node must have for the pods to be scheduled on it (`nodeSelector`). Overrides `podOptions.nodeSelector` for this workload.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Rules that spread the pods across topology domains such as nodes or zones (`topologySpreadConstraints`). Overrides `podOptions.topologySpreadConstraints` for this workload.

hostAliases.description: Extra entries for the `/etc/hosts` file of the pods (`hostAliases`). Overrides `podOptions.hostAliases` for this workload.

dnsPolicy.description: DNS policy of the pods (`dnsPolicy`): `ClusterFirst`, `ClusterFirstWithHostNet`, `Default` or `None`. It is forced to `ClusterFirstWithHostNet` when `hostNetwork` is `true`. Overrides `podOptions.dnsPolicy` for this workload.

dnsConfig.description: Extra DNS settings of the pods (`dnsConfig`). Overrides `podOptions.dnsConfig` for this workload.

tolerations.description: Taints the pods tolerate (`tolerations`). Overrides `podOptions.tolerations` for this workload.

runtimeClassName.description: Name of the RuntimeClass of the pods (`runtimeClassName`), to run them with another container runtime. Overrides `podOptions.runtimeClassName` for this workload.

podSpec.description: Settings of the pods of the workload: containers, init containers and pod level options.

revisionHistoryLimit.description: Number of old ReplicaSets, ControllerRevisions or history entries that are kept for rollbacks (`revisionHistoryLimit`).

strategy.description:
Update strategy of the workload. Deployments accept `Recreate` and `RollingUpdate`, StatefulSets and DaemonSets accept `RollingUpdate` and `OnDelete`. Set `maxUnavailable`, `maxSurge` and `partition` under `rollingUpdate`.

A Deployment with a single replica uses `Recreate` if it mounts a `ReadWriteOnce` volume.

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum number of pods that can be unavailable during an update, as a number or a percentage like `25%`. Only used when `strategy` is `RollingUpdate`.

partition.description: Pods with an ordinal lower than this number are not updated (`partition`). Only used when `strategy` is `RollingUpdate`.

maxSurge.description: Maximum number of pods that can be created above the desired number during an update, as a number or a percentage like `25%`. Only used when `strategy` is `RollingUpdate`.

rollingUpdate.description: Settings of the `RollingUpdate` strategy. Only used when `strategy` is `RollingUpdate`.

initContainers.description: Not used. Init containers go under `podSpec.initContainers`.

completionMode.description: Completion mode of a Job: `NonIndexed` or `Indexed` (`completionMode`).

backoffLimit.description: Number of retries before a Job is marked as failed (`backoffLimit`).

completions.description: Number of pods that must finish successfully for a Job to complete (`completions`).

parallelism.description: Maximum number of pods of a Job that run at the same time (`parallelism`).

ttlSecondsAfterFinished.description: Seconds after which a finished Job is deleted automatically (`ttlSecondsAfterFinished`).

activeDeadlineSeconds.description: Maximum number of seconds a Job can run before it is stopped (`activeDeadlineSeconds`).

schedule.description: Cron schedule of a CronJob, in the standard 5 field format (`schedule`).

suspend.description: Whether the CronJob is suspended, so no new Jobs start (`suspend`). Forced to `true` when `stopAll` is enabled.

timezone.description: Time zone of the schedule of a CronJob (`timeZone`), eg `Europe/Amsterdam`. Defaults to the `TZ` value.

concurrencyPolicy.description: What a CronJob does when the previous run is still running: `Allow` both, `Forbid` the new run or `Replace` the old one (`concurrencyPolicy`).

failedJobsHistoryLimit.description: Number of failed Jobs of a CronJob that are kept (`failedJobsHistoryLimit`).

successfulJobsHistoryLimit.description: Number of successful Jobs of a CronJob that are kept (`successfulJobsHistoryLimit`).

startingDeadlineSeconds.description: Seconds after the scheduled time in which a CronJob can still start a missed run (`startingDeadlineSeconds`).

enabled.description: Whether the workload is created.

primary.description: Whether this is the primary workload of the chart. A chart needs one primary workload.

annotationsList.description: Additional annotations as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the annotations of the workload.

labelsList.description: Additional labels as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the labels of the workload.

labels.description: Additional labels for the workload object.

annotations.description: Additional annotations for the workload object.

namespace.description: Namespace of the workload. Defaults to the namespace of the release.

type.description: Kind of the workload: `Deployment`, `DaemonSet`, `StatefulSet`, `CronJob` or `Job`.

serviceAccountName.description: Not used. Set the service account of the pods with `podSpec.serviceAccountName`, or with the top-level `serviceAccount` key and its `targetSelector`.

dbWait.description: Not used by common itself. Kept for compatibility with existing values.

additionalProperties.description: A workload, spawned as a Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, Job or CronJob.

workload.workload.description: Workloads of the chart, keyed by name.
